user_prompt: We need a way to automatically flag when new regulations affecting our supply chain contracts go into effect—right now our procurement team manually checks regulatory databases and emails everyone, but we keep missing updates that require contract amendments. Can we set up alerts that pull from official regulatory sources and automatically match relevant rules to our active vendor agreements?
